items.title: Show HN: AI-powered element monitoring for websites
items.raw_excerpt: Hi HN, I built SiteStable ( https://sitestable.co ) – a monitoring tool that uses AI to identify and track critical elements on your website. The problem: Traditional uptime monitors just check if your site returns 200 OK, but they don't catch when important elements break (checkout buttons disappear, forms stop rendering, critical CTAs vanish due to CSS/JS errors). How it works: 1. Enter your website URL 2. AI scans the page and identifies important elements (buttons, forms, navigation, etc.) 3. You choose which elements to monitor 4. Every 15 minutes, we check if those elements still exist on the page 5. Get alerted immediately if something disappears Also supports traditional HTTP endpoint monitoring for API/server uptime. title_i18n.en: Show HN: I got tired of rebuilding tool integrations for AI agent,so I built 2LY
title_i18n.zh: 展示 HN：我厌倦了为AI代理重建工具集成，于是打造了2LY。
title_i18n.es: Mostré en HN: Me cansé de reconstruir integraciones de herramientas para agentes de IA, así que creé 2LY.

excerpt_i18n.en: A developer built the open-source project 2LY to streamline tool integrations for AI agents, reducing repetitive development work.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 开发者因厌倦为AI代理重复构建工具集成，创建了开源项目2LY。该项目旨在简化AI代理的工具集成流程，提高开发效率。

items.title: AI can only automate 3% of remote work projects
items.raw_excerpt: Research indicates that AI can currently automate only about 3% of remote work projects, highlighting its limitations in this context.

title_i18n.en: AI can only automate 3% of remote work projects
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能仅能自动化3%的远程工作项目。
title_i18n.es: La inteligencia artificial solo puede automatizar el 3% de los proyectos de trabajo remoto.

excerpt_i18n.en: Research indicates that AI can currently automate only about 3% of remote work projects, highlighting its limitations in this context.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 研究表明，人工智能目前仅能自动化约3%的远程工作项目，突显了AI在远程工作场景中的局限性。这一发现基于对实际工作流程的分析，强调了人类在复杂任务中的不可替代性。

items.title: AI Agents Are Terrible Freelance Workers
items.raw_excerpt: A new benchmark measures how well AI agents can automate economically valuable chores. Human-level AI is still some ways off.

title_i18n.en: AI Agents Are Terrible Freelance Workers
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能代理作为自由职业者表现欠佳。
title_i18n.es: Los agentes de IA son pésimos trabajadores autónomos

excerpt_i18n.en: A new benchmark measures how well AI agents can automate economically valuable chores. Human-level AI is still some ways off.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 新基准评估AI代理在自动化经济价值家务任务上的表现，人类水平的人工智能仍有差距。
excerpt_i18n.es: Un nuevo punto de referencia mide cuán bien los agentes de IA pueden automatizar tareas económicamente valiosas. La IA a nivel humano aún está lejos.
